summary: Quirino representative with 37 principal-authored bills. Authored plastic-bag excise, fuel-tax suspension and relief, the national minimum wage, a digital peso, PNP retirement-age increase and barangay tanod as auxiliary police, and bank transparency.
caveat: Economic score rests on tax measures that cancel and one labor bill. Tanod and bank-transparency bills are single issues and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Fuel-excise suspension and relief (+1) with a plastic-bag excise (-1) net to 0 on tax; authored national minimum wage (-2). Two issues, thin.
